design_goal: Create a deterministic multi-source backup/fallback governance registry for all VDF and VRN data, while preserving Taiwan official-only and not-allowed source rules.

source_basis.user_rule: Taiwan stock/index data follows Taiwan-specific source rules; other data can use Yfinance / AkShare / FRED / Other fallback order.

histock.mixing_policy: not primary unless explicitly allowed by historical_validation_policy

wantgoo.mixing_policy: not primary unless explicitly allowed by S05 policy

global_governance_rules.name: source_lineage_required
global_governance_rules.rule: Every fetched or computed value must preserve source, source_tier, fetch_time, data_date, ticker, field_name, raw_value, normalized_value, and validation_status.

global_governance_rules.name: tw_equity_list_official_primary
global_governance_rules.rule: Taiwan stock list and official company attributes use TWSE/TPEX/MOPS as official source set. Yfinance is allowed only for yfinance ticker mapping, adjusted price support, beta inputs, or explicitly listed fields.

global_governance_rules.name: tw_price_yfinance_primary_no_other
global_governance_rules.rule: Taiwan stock OHLCV/Adj Close rows use Yfinance as fixed price source. Other Source is not allowed unless registry row explicitly permits it.

global_governance_rules.name: tw_chip_margin_daytrade_official_only
global_governance_rules.rule: Taiwan institutional trading, margin/short, and day-trading data use TWSE/TPEX only. Yfinance/AkShare/FRED/Other cannot fill these fields.

global_governance_rules.name: tw_index_price_yfinance_with_official_validation
global_governance_rules.rule: Taiwan index OHLCV/Adj price can use Yfinance as primary; TWSE/TPEX can be used as validation/other source when specified.

global_governance_rules.name: non_tw_default_fallback_order
global_governance_rules.rule: For non-Taiwan general market data, fallback order is Yfinance -> AkShare -> FRED -> Other.

global_governance_rules.name: macro_rates_exception
global_governance_rules.rule: Macro, rates, inflation, GDP, employment, and spreads may promote FRED to primary, then fallback to Yfinance -> AkShare -> Other.

global_governance_rules.name: not_allowed_means_hard_block
global_governance_rules.rule: If other_source is 'not allowed', fallback is disabled, cross-source fill is disabled, and missing data must be marked MISSING_OFFICIAL_OR_PRIMARY rather than filled.

global_governance_rules.name: twse_tpex_count_reconciliation
global_governance_rules.rule: TWSE and TPEX daily collection must compare expected count, fetched count, unique ticker count, duplicate count, missing ticker count, and per-field non-null count.

global_governance_rules.name: computed_lineage_required
global_governance_rules.rule: Calculated fields must store formula_id, formula_version, raw_fields, source_tiers_used, and quality_flag.

global_governance_rules.name: broker_opinion_preserved
global_governance_rules.rule: VRN broker opinion fields preserve broker report as sole truth; validation may flag but must not overwrite opinion values.

global_governance_rules.name: s05_dual_track_valuation
global_governance_rules.rule: S05 validates Track A with report-time/T-1 adjusted price and Track B with latest adjusted price; stale drift thresholds must be kept in audit.

global_governance_rules.name: quarantine_before_publish
global_governance_rules.rule: Rows failing source, ticker, date, geometry, or field validation are routed GREEN/YELLOW/RED before append-only publish.

hard_stop_conditions: official_only data requested from non_official provider

standard_attempt_steps.name: select_registry_row
standard_attempt_steps.action: Match Region + Classification + Market + Category + FieldName.

standard_attempt_steps.name: resolve_provider_order
standard_attempt_steps.action: Use row.source_priority; if non-TW default row, use Yfinance -> AkShare -> FRED -> Other.

standard_attempt_steps.name: fetch_primary
standard_attempt_steps.action: Fetch primary provider only within allowed scope.

standard_attempt_steps.name: validate_shape
standard_attempt_steps.action: Check schema, required fields, date range, ticker count, duplicate keys, and non-null coverage.

standard_attempt_steps.name: fallback_if_allowed
standard_attempt_steps.action: Only try next provider when fallback_allowed is true and provider is in fallback_order.

standard_attempt_steps.name: normalize
standard_attempt_steps.action: Normalize names, ticker, date, numeric units, source tier, and data types.

standard_attempt_steps.name: calculate
standard_attempt_steps.action: Calculate derived fields with formula_id/formula_version and raw field lineage.

standard_attempt_steps.name: reconcile
standard_attempt_steps.action: For TWSE/TPEX official sets and VRN S05, generate reconciliation matrix.

standard_attempt_steps.name: quarantine
standard_attempt_steps.action: Route missing/conflicting rows GREEN/YELLOW/RED before publish.

standard_attempt_steps.name: publish
standard_attempt_steps.action: Append output to Parquet/CSV/DuckDB/JSONL/HTML with run manifest.
